title: scribbit-mint-api environment
description: Environment of the HTTP server (src/main.ts, parsed by src/config.ts). One process serves one network. There are no secrets: every upstream is public or read-only and the service never sees a key. Values are strings, as in any environment.

PUBLIC_URL.description: Absolute base URL clients use (behind the edge). Advertised on GET /.

MINT_NETWORK.description: Network this process serves. The front end's VITE_NETWORK must match.

ESPLORA_URL.description: Esplora/mempool REST base for UTXOs, tx lookups and broadcasts, e.g. https://mempool.space/api, https://mempool.space/testnet4/api or a self-hosted backend. Default: public mempool.space for the network (none for regtest: required there).

CP_API_URL.description: Counterparty Core v2 base, e.g. https://api.counterparty.io:4000/v2 or a self-hosted node. Unset: every /api/cp/* call answers 503 cp_unavailable (the ordinals page keeps working).

FEE_URL.description: Fee source: a scribb.it fee server URL ending in /v1/fees (contracts/openapi/scribbit-fees.yaml) or a mempool.space-compatible base URL. Default: public mempool.space for the network. `off` disables /api/fees (503).

CORS_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated browser origins allowed to call the API, e.g. https://scribb.it,https://mint.scribb.it. Default none: browsers are refused by CORS. Use http://localhost:5173 in development.

TRUSTED_PROXIES.description: Comma-separated CIDRs of proxies we run. X-Forwarded-For is read only from them (client IP for rate limits). Leave unset when the service is reachable directly.

RATE_LIMIT_IP_PER_MIN.description: Token bucket per client IP, every route.

RATE_LIMIT_WRITE_PER_MIN.description: Second bucket per client IP on POST routes (broadcasts, composes).

MAX_COMPOSE_BYTES.description: Body limit for compose POSTs (413 above). A 4 MiB description in hex is 8 MiB.

MAX_BROADCAST_BYTES.description: Body limit for broadcasts (raw tx hex).

UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Per-call upstream timeout (504 upstream_timeout past it).
